scheme_name: Theka Shramik, Gharelu Mahila Kamgar Evan Hamaal Shramik Ke Bachcho Hetu Chhaatravrtti Yojana
other_conditions: The applicant's father or mother must be a registered sanitation worker in the state of Chhattisgarh.
Benefits are provided for up to two children per family.
Scholarship recipients must study for at least one year and cannot discontinue studies without returning the scholarship.
Students cannot receive benefits from two government scholarship schemes simultaneously.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for higher education of children of sanitation workers, with annual scholarship amounts ranging from ₹500 to ₹5,000 depending on class and gender.
